tasks.short: Calculate materials, supplier charges and allocated overhead for each site.

today.trigger: A site manager requests a cost estimate, or a supplier sends revised prices.
steps: Collect quotations, price lists, quantities and the approved overhead allocation method.
Check dates, units, discounts, transport charges and VAT treatment.
Calculate costs in Excel and compare them with recent AFAS purchases.
Resolve unclear assumptions with the requester and save the calculation.
drudgery: Copying prices from attachments into Excel.
Converting pack sizes and checking repeated formulas.
Finding which quotation is current.
today.time_sinks: Interpreting inconsistent quotations and chasing missing quantities; arithmetic is already largely handled by Excel. This is an assumed workflow to validate.

lenses.faster: Extract quotation lines into a standard table and calculate from approved formulas. Repeated copying, unit conversion and formula checking disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A new quotation can trigger extraction, validation and a draft calculation. Missing units, unclear exclusions and changed allocation rules go to the bookkeeper.
lenses.ambitious: Check quoted prices against subsequent invoices across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo. Show whether savings survive delivery charges, minimum orders and actual volumes.
lenses.joy: Remove attachment handling and repetitive arithmetic. Keep the investigation of unusual costs and conversations that improve supplier terms.
lenses.options: Compare suppliers, order quantities and allocation bases using the same demand assumptions. Show which assumptions change the preferred option.
lenses.altitude: Maintain the price register, calculation rules and exception thresholds instead of rebuilding spreadsheets.
reach: Prepare purchasing comparisons for site managers.
Provide documented cost assumptions to FP&A.
Identify supplier price differences for the Controller.

tasks.human_edge: Judge whether a quote covers the operational need and whether an overhead allocation is commercially sensible.
tasks.pattern_why: llm_step: use a model only to extract inconsistent quotation text into checkable fields. Deterministic formulas calculate money; a person resolves ambiguous terms and approves the resulting estimate.

in_practice.trigger: A quotation is placed in a designated SharePoint folder with a cost request reference.
steps: Extract supplier, effective dates, quantities, units, prices and exclusions, retaining source references.
Validate required fields and compare prices with the approved price register.
Calculate totals using versioned formulas, including approved overhead and VAT treatment.
Produce a comparison and route ambiguous or changed assumptions for review.
Save the approved calculation and its supporting quotations.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper approves each calculation; the Controller approves new allocation methods. Purchasing commitments follow the existing approval process.
data_needed: Supplier quotations and price lists with effective dates
Quantities and standard units
Approved overhead allocation rules
Relevant AFAS purchase history
VAT treatment approved by the Accountant
in_practice.logs_to: A versioned SharePoint calculation register containing source documents, extracted fields, formula version, exceptions and approval.

evidence.claim: Extracting quotation fields followed by deterministic arithmetic is technically plausible; ambiguous commercial terms still require review.
The proposed 50% labour saving and 2x end-to-end speedup are planning assumptions, not measured Noordhaven results; approval waiting could reduce the speedup.

risks: A misread decimal, pack size or price validity date changes the result materially.
An allocation method can produce a precise but misleading site cost.
Quoted instructions must be treated as document content, never as commands to the extraction service.
Existing Excel templates may already remove much of the proposed work.
research_questions: How much of the stated 40 hours is copying and checking rather than resolving commercial assumptions?
What proportion of quotations have consistent units, explicit exclusions and usable effective dates?
Can a sample of recent calculations be reproduced without unexplained differences?
Who owns overhead rules and approves changes across the three sites?

tasks.short: Match Rabobank transactions to customer receipts, supplier payments and the AFAS bank ledger.

today.trigger: A bank statement arrives or a bank reconciliation is due.
steps: Receive or import Rabobank statement transactions into AFAS.
Run existing matching against invoices, payment batches and bank posting rules.
Investigate unmatched receipts, partial payments, fees and reversals.
Check statement balances against the ledger and document unresolved items.
drudgery: Repeating searches for invoice references.
Checking the same recurring bank charges.
Rebuilding lists of outstanding reconciliation items.
today.time_sinks: Unclear remittance references, combined payments and old suspense items. Confirm how much AFAS matching is already enabled before estimating additional savings.

lenses.faster: Configure AFAS matching and recurring posting rules before adding AI. The bookkeeper receives a reconciled statement and a short exception queue.
lenses.autonomous: Statement arrival triggers completeness checks, exact matching and approved recurring postings. Ambiguous allocations and differences remain open for review.
lenses.ambitious: Keep bank and clearing accounts reconciled daily so close starts with fewer unresolved items. Track repeated causes of unmatched customer receipts.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated reference searches and balance copying. Keep investigations that recover missing receipts or uncover posting errors.
lenses.options: For an unmatched receipt, show ranked invoice combinations and supporting references. Suggestions stay unposted until the bookkeeper selects one.
lenses.altitude: Own matching quality, stale exceptions and rule changes instead of processing every statement line.
reach: Supply payment-allocation evidence to the Credit and Collections Officer.
Prepare bank and clearing-account evidence for the Accountant.
Provide reconciled cash movements to FP&A.

tasks.human_edge: Resolve disputed allocations and recognise suspicious transactions that satisfy a superficial matching rule.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: statement totals, identifiers and approved posting rules are structured and checkable. Use existing AFAS functions for routine processing; optional model suggestions must not clear ambiguous items.

in_practice.trigger: A Rabobank statement becomes available through the configured connection or an authorised file import.
steps: Check account, statement continuity, duplicate transaction identifiers and opening-to-closing balance movement.
Run approved AFAS matching and recurring transaction rules.
Post permitted matches and verify the resulting bank and clearing-account balances.
Queue ambiguous receipts, reversals and remaining differences with supporting evidence.
Record exception decisions and include rule changes in a separate approval queue.
in_practice.human_gate: A person approves ambiguous allocations, write-offs and new rules. Supplier bank-detail changes and payment release remain separately authorised.
data_needed: Complete bank statements and account balances
AFAS open receivables and payables
Payment batch and clearing-account details
Approved matching rules and posting tolerances
Known reversals and disputed receipts
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS posting history and a SharePoint reconciliation register with statement identifiers, rule versions, balance checks and exception approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports automatic statement processing after import and transaction-code rules for recurring postings.
A further 60% labour saving and 2.5x end-to-end speedup depend on the current match rate and timely exception review; they are unmeasured estimates.

risks: An incorrect automatic match can conceal an unpaid invoice.
Missing or duplicated statement transactions can produce an incomplete reconciliation.
Payment batches and individual statement lines can be counted twice.
Aggressive tolerances can hide discrepancies in suspense or write-off accounts.
research_questions: What percentage of transactions already match automatically in AFAS, by count and value?
Does the Rabobank connection provide complete statements for every relevant account?
Which exception types consume most time, and can approved rules resolve them safely?
Can a replay of recent statements reproduce approved allocations and closing balances without false matches?

tasks.short: Prepare reconciled cash, payables, receivables and profit reports for Finance.

today.trigger: A recurring reporting deadline or a request from the Controller or Finance Director.
steps: Retrieve AFAS ledger and subledger reports and check the latest Power BI refresh.
Align periods, site codes, account mappings and report definitions.
Reconcile totals and compile the requested Excel tables.
Explain unusual movements and share the checked report.
drudgery: Exporting the same tables repeatedly.
Repairing mappings and copying figures between templates.
Checking whether recipients have the latest version.
today.time_sinks: Reconciling inconsistent cut-off dates and investigating movements. Power BI already automates part of the reporting, so incremental gains need measurement.

lenses.faster: Use one governed dataset and reusable report definitions. Repeated exports, spreadsheet joins and formatting largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A successful nightly extract triggers checks and refreshes standard internal tables. Failed reconciliations block publication and create an exception.
lenses.ambitious: Provide daily visibility of overdue balances, supplier exposure and cash movements by site. Give close and forecast teams the same reconciled figures.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet assembly and version chasing. Keep explaining movements that help colleagues act.
lenses.options: Offer views by site, customer, supplier and ageing band from the same reconciled totals. Any narrative draft links back to the underlying figures.
lenses.altitude: Own report definitions, reconciliations and data quality instead of producing each table separately.
reach: Prepare supporting schedules for the Accountant.
Provide receivables analysis to Credit and Collections.
Supply actuals and cash-movement tables to FP&A.

tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a genuine business movement from timing, classification or missing data, and explain its significance.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: joins, aggregations and reconciliations should use defined calculations. A model may draft commentary from verified results, but it should not calculate or invent report figures.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly AFAS extract completes successfully.
steps: Validate extract freshness, row counts, site mappings and control totals.
Build standard tables using approved account and ageing definitions.
Reconcile ledger, receivables, payables and cash totals on a consistent date basis.
Refresh standard internal reports only when checks pass and display the data timestamp.
Route unusual movements and optional draft explanations to the bookkeeper.
in_practice.human_gate: Approved recurring tables can refresh automatically after checks pass. The bookkeeper reviews commentary and new report definitions; the Controller approves formal close reporting.
data_needed: Ledger entries and account balances
Open receivables and payables
Approved site and account mappings
Definitions for ageing, cash movements and profit measures
Extract timestamps and reconciliation totals
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint report-control register containing dataset versions, refresh timestamps, reconciliation results, publication status and commentary approval.

evidence.claim: Power Query can combine files with a common schema into one table; this supports repeatable preparation of standard extracts.
AFAS provides financial reporting including balance sheets, profit-and-loss statements and budget comparisons.
The 60% labour saving and 2.5x end-to-end speedup are unmeasured estimates for report preparation after source data is available; the nightly refresh delay remains.

risks: A dashboard can appear current while its AFAS extract is stale.
Different invoice-date and posting-date selections create misleading differences.
Incorrect site mappings or ageing definitions can distort otherwise correct totals.
Draft commentary can invent causes; explanations need evidence and review.
Payroll-related reports need restricted access and appropriately aggregated employee data under AVG/GDPR.
research_questions: Which reports are still assembled manually despite existing Power BI dashboards?
Can every published total be traced to an AFAS control total and a recorded cut-off?
How often do refresh failures or mapping changes require manual repair?
Would users accept the nightly refresh, or does their decision require a fresher source?

tasks.short: Prepare the trial balance and flag balances that need investigation before close.

today.trigger: A month-close checkpoint or an Accountant request.
steps: Run the AFAS trial balance for the requested administration and period.
Check debit and credit totals and compare balances with the previous period.
Tie bank, receivables and payables balances to their supporting records.
Investigate differences and send the trial balance with unresolved items to the Accountant.
drudgery: Repeating the same control-account comparisons.
Copying balances into close schedules.
Rerunning checks after late postings.
today.time_sinks: Investigating differences and late entries, rather than generating the trial balance itself.

lenses.faster: Generate the trial balance with control-account reconciliations and movement checks attached. Repeated schedule population disappears.
lenses.autonomous: A close checkpoint triggers the checks and reruns them after relevant late postings. Exceptions remain visible until resolved or explicitly accepted.
lenses.ambitious: Run selected close checks throughout the month so errors surface before the deadline. Measure which recurring exceptions delay close.
lenses.joy: Remove balance copying and repeated comparison work. Keep investigating the accounting issues behind unexplained balances.
lenses.options: Show balances before and after proposed corrections, with a bridge between versions. Keep proposed journals separate from posted results.
lenses.altitude: Maintain the close-check catalogue, evidence requirements and exception ownership.
reach: Prepare control-account schedules for the Accountant.
Maintain the Controller's close-exception register.
Assemble supporting evidence for audit queries.

tasks.human_edge: Recognise missing liabilities, wrong-period entries and unsupported balances even when total debits equal credits.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: AFAS already produces the trial balance. The useful extension is repeatable reconciliation and exception checking; accounting conclusions and corrective journals retain human approval.

in_practice.trigger: A scheduled close checkpoint or a new posting affecting a checked period.
steps: Capture an AFAS trial balance with the administration, period and extraction timestamp.
Check debit-credit equality and reconcile designated control accounts using consistent posting-date selections.
Flag unexpected signs, dormant-account activity, large movements and aged clearing balances.
Assign exceptions with source transactions and supporting schedules.
Regenerate the evidence pack after approved corrections and record Accountant sign-off.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper resolves routine differences; the Accountant approves corrective journals and final readiness. A balanced trial balance alone never authorises close.
systems: Excel or Power BI control schedules
data_needed: Trial balance and underlying journal entries
Bank reconciliation results
Receivables and payables control reports
Previous-period balances
Approved thresholds and close-check definitions
in_practice.logs_to: The SharePoint close dossier, with AFAS report references, check results, exception decisions, journal approvals and successive balance versions.

evidence.claim: AFAS documents that open-item lists and trial balances can use different date bases and provides posting-date control reports for reconciliation.
A 40% labour saving and approximately 1.67x end-to-end speedup are unmeasured estimates for preparation and checking; unresolved accounting issues can dominate elapsed time.

risks: Debit-credit equality does not detect omitted or misclassified transactions.
Late journals can invalidate previously completed checks.
Date-basis differences can generate false reconciliation exceptions.
Automatic balancing entries could hide errors and must not be used to force agreement.
research_questions: How much of the 32.4 hours is report generation versus reconciliation and investigation?
Which control accounts repeatedly delay close?
Can each reconciliation use the same posting-date basis and a reproducible source snapshot?
Can the checks detect known historical close errors without producing an unmanageable exception queue?

tasks.short: Assemble actuals, supplier commitments and approved assumptions for the budget and forecast.

today.trigger: FP&A starts a budget round or requests a forecast update.
steps: Collect AFAS actuals, previous budgets and current supplier or agency rate information.
Request missing revenue, volume and expense assumptions from their owners.
Map inputs to accounts, sites and periods in the budget workbook.
Check completeness, explain differences and hand the compiled pack to FP&A.
drudgery: Collecting multiple workbook versions.
Aligning account codes and month columns.
Chasing inputs without a clear owner or due date.
today.time_sinks: Resolving inconsistent assumptions and waiting for business inputs. Data assembly can improve faster than forecast judgement.

lenses.faster: Refresh actuals and prior budgets into a controlled template and validate submitted inputs automatically. Manual consolidation and repeated mapping disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A new forecast cycle creates the input checklist and refreshes available data. Missing inputs and changed assumptions appear in an owner queue.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a documented monthly view of recurring spend, agency commitments and missing invoices. Give FP&A earlier evidence of cost changes at each site.
lenses.joy: Remove workbook merging and version chasing. Keep conversations that explain unusual spend or weak assumptions.
lenses.options: Prepare base, higher-volume and lower-volume input packs using assumptions approved by FP&A. Show the cash and cost effects of different agency volumes and supplier rates.
lenses.altitude: Own budget-input quality, provenance and completeness rather than assembling each submission by hand.
reach: Maintain cost-input schedules for FP&A.
Validate supplier and agency cost assumptions with site managers.
Prepare actual-to-budget spending bridges for the Controller.

tasks.human_edge: Challenge unsupported inputs and distinguish contracted commitments from aspirations or estimates.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: this task compiles approved inputs rather than deciding the budget. Structured imports, mappings and validation do most of the work; FP&A and budget owners retain assumption and forecast decisions.

in_practice.trigger: FP&A opens a budget or forecast cycle with a defined cut-off and template.
steps: Freeze the actuals cut-off and collect prior budgets, approved rates and available commitments.
Map inputs to accounts, sites and months using a versioned mapping table.
Validate coverage, duplicates, units and changes from the previous submission.
Generate scenario input packs from explicitly approved drivers and identify missing inputs.
Obtain owner confirmation and deliver a versioned pack to FP&A.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper checks the compiled pack; site managers confirm their inputs and FP&A approves assumptions. Approved CAO-related labour costs come from Payroll or Compensation and Benefits.
systems: Staffing agency portal exports where available
data_needed: Actuals and previous budgets by account, site and month
Supplier agreements and available commitment records
Agency rates and approved volume assumptions
Aggregate labour-cost assumptions approved by Payroll
Revenue and operational drivers approved by FP&A
Input owners, cut-off dates and version history
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint forecast-input register linking each submission to its source, owner, assumption version, validation results and approval.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports budget scenarios and changes by account, period and cost centre.
A 50% labour saving and 2x end-to-end speedup are unmeasured estimates for compilation; late business submissions may prevent the elapsed-time gain.

risks: Automating compilation does not make an unsupported forecast trustworthy.
Agency labour and employee labour can be counted twice or assigned to the wrong period.
A blanket percentage uplift can miss different CAO effects and supplier contract terms.
Detailed payroll data could be exposed unnecessarily; aggregate inputs and restricted access are needed.
research_questions: Which inputs are already structured, and which arrive as inconsistent spreadsheets or emails?
How much delay comes from compilation versus late decisions by budget owners?
Are agency rates, commitments and labour assumptions available with clear effective dates and owners?
Can the compiled pack reconcile to AFAS actuals and reproduce the previous approved budget?

tasks.short: Keep financial inventory records aligned with site movements, counts and supplier documents.

today.trigger: A stock movement, site count or month-end inventory reconciliation.
steps: Obtain the available site stock records, count sheets and purchase documents.
Identify ownership, item codes, quantities and movement dates.
Update the financial stock schedule and compare it with site records.
Investigate differences and prepare supported adjustments for approval.
systems: Site stock records; the operational inventory system is unspecified
drudgery: Rekeying count sheets and receipts.
Matching different site item codes.
Rebuilding the same movement reconciliation.
today.time_sinks: Missing movement records and unclear ownership. This workflow needs confirmation because no warehouse inventory system or inventory scope was supplied.

lenses.faster: Import available stock movements into a standard register and calculate the expected balance. Repeated entry and spreadsheet reconciliation disappear where reliable source records exist.
lenses.autonomous: Validated movement files update the register and flag duplicates, negative quantities and unmatched items. Valuation changes and unexplained differences await approval.
lenses.ambitious: Reconcile company-owned stock across all three sites more frequently and target recurring differences for investigation. Keep customer-owned goods separately identified.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive copying and code matching. Keep practical investigations with site teams.
lenses.options: Show the financial effect of alternative explanations such as timing, a missing receipt or an incorrect unit. Do not turn those explanations into adjustments automatically.
lenses.altitude: Own the financial reconciliation rules and exception quality while site teams own physical custody and counts.
reach: Prepare inventory evidence for the Accountant.
Coordinate difference investigations with site stock administrators.
Provide supported loss and adjustment analysis to the Controller.

tasks.human_edge: Establish what physically exists, who owns it and whether a discrepancy reflects timing, damage or loss.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: item movements and balance roll-forwards are rule-based once reliable records exist. Automation cannot establish physical stock or ownership from incomplete spreadsheets.

in_practice.trigger: An authorised site movement file or count sheet is added to the agreed intake folder.
steps: Validate source, item identifiers, units, ownership, dates and duplicate movement keys.
Update a proposed stock register using approved item mappings and movement rules.
Calculate opening stock plus receipts less issues and compare with counts and financial records.
Route differences to the site owner and prepare supported adjustment proposals.
Apply approved financial updates and retain the reconciliation evidence.
in_practice.human_gate: The bookkeeper approves each update batch initially; site staff confirm physical differences and the Accountant approves write-offs and valuation journals.
systems: Existing site stock source, subject to discovery
data_needed: A defined list of inventory covered by this role
Item master, units and ownership indicators
Opening balances and dated movements
Authorised count results
Approved valuation rules and adjustment authority
in_practice.logs_to: A SharePoint inventory reconciliation register with source-file identifiers, movement keys, ownership, differences and adjustment approvals.

evidence.claim: Power Query can consolidate consistent movement files; this supports a financial stock register but does not establish inventory accuracy.
The proposed 35% labour saving and approximately 1.54x end-to-end speedup depend on inventory scope and source quality, neither of which is established.

risks: Customer-owned goods could be incorrectly recorded as Noordhaven assets.
Incomplete movement records can make a clean reconciliation misleading.
Wrong units or item mappings can multiply quantity errors.
Financial automation cannot replace physical counts or establish damaged-stock condition.
research_questions: Does this task cover consumables, company-owned goods, customer-owned goods or another inventory category?
What operational stock system or register exists at each site, and can it export reliable movements?
Are ownership, units and item codes consistent across the three sites?
Would a recent count reconcile through the proposed movement rules without unsupported adjustments?

tasks.short: Prepare Dutch tax and contribution submissions with the responsible Accountant or Payroll Specialist.

today.trigger: A filing deadline, correction request or contribution reporting cycle.
steps: Confirm which Dutch return or document is required and who owns it.
Collect relevant AFAS accounting or approved payroll totals.
Populate the submission and reconcile it to its supporting records.
Obtain the responsible specialist's approval and submit through the authorised channel.
Save the acknowledgement and hand any payment instruction to the payment process.
systems: Relevant tax or pension submission channel
drudgery: Re-entering totals already held in AFAS.
Collecting supporting schedules and approval evidence.
Checking whether a submission was accepted.
today.time_sinks: Resolving tax treatment, payroll differences and rejected submissions. The O*NET statement mixes jurisdictions; a US-style workers' compensation form must not be assumed to apply.

lenses.faster: Populate recurring returns from reconciled AFAS data and assemble the evidence automatically. Repeated transcription and acknowledgement chasing largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A filing calendar triggers preparation, validation and an approval request. Submission occurs only after approval, and acceptance status is recorded.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a complete register of applicable filings, owners, evidence and acceptance status. Detect missing source data before the deadline week.
lenses.joy: Remove rekeying and searching for submission receipts. Keep resolving genuine differences with the Accountant or Payroll Specialist.
lenses.options: Show the effect of alternative treatments for specialist review with the underlying transactions attached. The system does not choose a tax position.
lenses.altitude: Maintain the filing checklist, reconciliations and evidence trail while specialists retain interpretation and accountability.
reach: Prepare VAT supporting schedules for the Accountant.
Reconcile pension or payroll contribution totals under the Payroll Specialist's direction.
Maintain submission evidence for audit requests.

tasks.human_edge: Determine applicability and treatment, challenge unusual transactions and accept responsibility for the approved submission.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: the workflow spans data collection, reconciliation, approval, submission and acknowledgement. Calculations and filing formats remain deterministic; an authorised specialist approves every submission before it counts.

in_practice.trigger: An approved filing calendar reaches the preparation date for an applicable Dutch submission.
steps: Identify the filing, period, owner, current form requirements and authorised submission route.
Collect the required AFAS totals and validate completeness against the ledger or payroll control reports.
Generate a draft and supporting reconciliation, flagging unusual treatment or missing data.
Obtain approval from the Accountant or Payroll Specialist and submit the exact approved version through the configured channel.
Capture acceptance or rejection, route failures for correction and hand payment details to the separate payment approval process.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant approves accounting and VAT submissions; the Payroll Specialist owns payroll and pension submissions. Filing approval does not authorise payment.
systems: Configured tax or pension submission channel
data_needed: Confirmed filing obligations, periods and owners
Reconciled VAT or other relevant ledger balances
Approved payroll and pension totals where applicable
Current submission schemas and authorised access
Prior submissions, corrections and acceptance receipts
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint filing dossier containing source totals, reconciliation, exact approved payload, approver, submission identifier and acceptance receipt.

evidence.claim: The Belastingdienst accepts VAT returns through Mijn Belastingdienst Zakelijk, accounting software or a tax service provider.
AFAS documents VAT submission messages through its communications service; Noordhaven's configuration and authorisation still require verification.
The 35% labour saving and approximately 1.54x end-to-end speedup are unmeasured estimates; specialist approval and external acceptance may limit elapsed-time gains.

risks: Incorrect tax treatment can produce a technically accepted but substantively wrong return.
A transmission receipt may not establish acceptance; rejection handling needs an owner.
Retries can create duplicate submissions unless status is checked first.
Payroll and pension records contain personal data requiring restricted access and approved processing under AVG/GDPR.
The applicable pension arrangement and CAO must be confirmed by Payroll; the bookkeeper should not infer them from job titles.
research_questions: Which Dutch submissions does the bookkeeper actually prepare, and which belong entirely to the Accountant or Payroll Specialist?
Which submission channels and approval controls are already configured in AFAS?
Can recent submissions be reproduced from reconciled source totals, including corrections?
Can the workflow reliably distinguish accepted, rejected and uncertain submissions without duplicate filing?

role.altitude: Become the owner of reliable transaction flows and supporting evidence: maintain rules, resolve exceptions and deliver reconciled inputs that help Finance close and forecast sooner.
reach: Prepare reconciliations and audit schedules currently assembled by the Accountants.
Support Credit and Collections with receipt allocation and documented disputes.
Maintain supplier cost and agency invoice comparisons for site managers.
Provide governed actuals, commitments and cost-input schedules to FP&A.
Coordinate financial inventory differences with site stock administrators.
role.ceiling_note: These seven tasks total 215.6 hours per FTE annually, about 13.5% of the supplied role baseline. The illustrative savings total about 317 hours across three FTE, worth approximately EUR 14,264 of annual capacity at EUR 45/hour before implementation, licences and maintenance. This is about 0.20 FTE using the implied 1,600-hour year, not a staffing reduction. Work already automated in AFAS or Power BI lowers the opportunity. Savings overlap with adjacent roles and must not be counted twice; fewer close days require removing actual critical-path delays.
skills_to_grow: Configure and test AFAS matching, control reports and posting rules.
Build maintainable Excel Power Query transformations and understand Power BI refresh controls.
Design reconciliations, exception queues and evidence trails.
Check document extraction against source quotations and invoices.
Understand accounting cut-offs, inventory ownership and VAT escalation boundaries.
Explain operational cost movements clearly to site managers and FP&A.
Apply AVG/GDPR data minimisation and recognise when employee-related changes require OR or EU AI Act assessment.
role.ambitious_version: Run a daily finance readiness service across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo: reconciled bank balances, visible receipt-allocation exceptions, traceable cost inputs and early close checks. The three bookkeepers improve the rules and resolve the exceptions with site teams, while the Accountant, Controller and Payroll Specialist retain their approval responsibilities. Measure success through fewer unresolved items at close, reliable forecast inputs and fewer audit adjustments.
